# poolex v1.6.3 - Table of Contents

The library for managing pools of workers.

## Modules

- [Poolex](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.md): ## Usage
- [Poolex.Caller](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Caller.md): Caller structure.
- [Poolex.Callers.Behaviour](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Callers.Behaviour.md): Behaviour for callers collection implementations.
- [Poolex.Callers.Impl.ErlangQueue](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Callers.Impl.ErlangQueue.md): Callers queue (FIFO) implementation based on `:erlang.queue`.

- [Poolex.Private.DebugInfo](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Private.DebugInfo.md): Information with the current state of the pool.
- [Poolex.Private.Metrics](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Private.Metrics.md): Functions for dispatching metrics.

- [Poolex.Private.State](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Private.State.md): Internal structure containing the state of the pool.
- [Poolex.Workers.Behaviour](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Workers.Behaviour.md): Behaviour for worker collection implementations.

- [Poolex.Workers.Impl.ErlangQueue](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Workers.Impl.ErlangQueue.md): Simple workers queue (FIFO) implementation based on Erlang `:queue`

- [Poolex.Workers.Impl.List](https://poolex.hexdocs.pm/Poolex.Workers.Impl.List.md): Simple workers stack (LIFO) implementation based on List.
